text.en: Reviewers praise instructors like Elena for their encouraging attitude, clear explanations, and hands-on demonstrations. Dog owners value how trainers break complex commands down into manageable steps, creating a truly supportive learning environment.

Clients report lasting progress in impulse control, basic obedience, and leash manners through force-free methods. Pet parents note that structured puppy exercises successfully curb unwanted breed behaviors and prepare young dogs for real-world situations.

Puppy owners consistently highlight the supervised puppy socials as a fun, positive venue for young dogs to interact and play. Reviewers appreciate that sessions help pups develop confidence around other dogs while forming a welcoming local community.

q.en: What training methodology does When Hounds Fly use?

a.en: The school uses positive reinforcement and clicker training, focusing on humane, science-based methods without force or intimidation.

q.en: Can dog owners schedule classes at their own pace?

a.en: Yes, clients appreciate the flexible modular scheduling that allows owners to book classes weekly or biweekly as their calendar permits.

q.en: Are puppy socialization sessions offered at this location?

a.en: Yes, the school hosts regular structured puppy socials for young dogs to safely interact under trainer supervision.

q.en: What is the policy regarding class cancellations or package transfers?

a.en: The school offers class credits and remote transfer options, though reviewers note that refund policies for unused sessions are strict.
